_doc: The jail map (world/innerMap/jail.js, ui/innerMapJail.js): the names of the other prisoners and the gaoler, and what they say. The cellmates themselves are named by player/prison.js (data/underworld.json → prison). transport: the march when sentenced where there is no jail (villages) — to the nearest town of jailTypes (the same crown first), hexesPerDay; each day on the road raiders may fall on the escort (raid: base chance, more per hostile band within radius hexes, capped at max), or a guard offers to loose you for coin (bribe), a wheel breaks (delay: a day lost), a kindness or a cruelty (health). Raid choices: slip (stealth, agility — an escape), fight (combat, strength — the captain takes reward share off the sentence), stay (the guards win guardsWin of the time; else the raiders take you into servitude takenShare of the rest, or rob you and leave you free). lines: {town}, {from}, {left}, {cost}, {days}, {took}, {added}, {cut}. zones: places the player may not go (tile._zone; ui/innerMapZones.js). jail_cells — the cells and the corridor behind the gaol's front room, closed to visitors: the warden (the gaoler) warns the first time, and at the second step in (or graceSeconds lingering after the warning) shouts and attacks.
prisonerLines: I didn't do it. None of us did.
Rats again last night. Big as cats.
Three winters I've been in here.
The gaoler's soft on coin, if you've any.
gaolerLines: Bread at dusk. If you're lucky.

quiet: The escort marches on. Your wrists are raw under the irons.
A long day on the road. The guards talk of a girl in {town}.
Rain all day. The chains are cold and the guards are colder.
You pass a gibbet at a crossroads. The guards laugh.
Farmers stop work to watch the prisoner go by.
{left} day(s) more to {town}, says the sergeant.
raid: Arrows from the treeline! Raiders fall on the escort.
A band of raiders blocks the road, blades out. The guards close round the cart.
Shouts in the dusk — riders coming hard. Raiders!
bribe: The youngest guard sidles up at the fire. "{cost} gold, and your chains come loose tonight."
A guard eyes your purse. "For {cost} gold I sleep sound and you walk."
delay: A cart wheel splits in a rut. A day lost mending it.
A flooded ford. The escort waits a day for the water to fall.
kindness: A farmwife presses bread and a cup of milk into your hands.
An old priest on the road says a prayer for you and shares his water.
cruelty: A guard takes his temper out on you with the butt of his spear.
They make you walk behind the horses, in the dust, all day.
arrive: You are marched through the gates of {town} in chains, to its gaol.
The walls of {town} at last — and its gaol.

outcomes.slipped: In the fight you slip your chains and run for the trees. No one follows — yet.
outcomes.slipCaught: A guard rides you down: +{added} days, and a beating for your trouble.
outcomes.fought: You snatch up a fallen blade and fight beside the guards. When it is over the captain takes {cut} days off your sentence.
outcomes.foughtHurt: You throw yourself into the fight and are cut for it. The guards drive the raiders off without you.
outcomes.guardsWin: You keep your head down. The guards drive the raiders off.
outcomes.taken: The escort breaks and scatters. The raiders take you for themselves — {days} days in their chains.
outcomes.abandoned: The escort breaks and flees. The raiders take {took} gold and leave you chained in the road. By dark you have worked the irons loose — free.
outcomes.bribePaid: You press {cost} gold into his hand. Before dawn your chains are loose and the guard is snoring.
outcomes.bribeRefused: You keep your coin. The guard spits and walks off.

warn: Oi! No one goes back there. Out!
Where do you think you're going? Back to the front, now.
jail_cells.warnNote: Go back to the front room.
attack: I warned you! You want a cell of your own?
Told you once. Now you learn.
jail_cells.attackNote: You were told to stay out front.
